title: Four Days' Battle
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Four Days' Battle", at revision 1382431627, opens: "The Four Days' Battle was a naval engagement fought from 11 to 14 June 1666 during the Second Anglo-Dutch War. It began off the Flemish coast and ended near the English coast, and remains one of the longest naval battles in history." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q734934, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "naval battle in June 1666". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
